name: meu-bling
description: ERP completo do Balão da Informática — substituto do Bling (vendas, compras, OS, NF-e A1, financeiro/Open Finance, comissões, dashboards, DRE, e-mail e WhatsApp)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
